name: image-url-field
title: Image URL field
description: Paste an image address and see it load: a live thumbnail, a clear failed state and optional https-only, with no server call.
docs: value and onValueChange(url, { status, width, height }) speak the address. The thumbnail is a plain image element in the field, so no script fetches anything and no server is involved; the request carries referrerPolicy no-referrer and the thumbnail has an empty alt because the label names the field. status is empty, loading, loaded (with the natural size in pixels), failed (That address did not load as an image, also after 15 seconds without an answer) or invalid, an address turned down before any request: not an address, http:// when requireHttps is on, a data: address unless allowData is on, and any scheme other than https, http and data:image. onValueChange is called on every change and again whenever what is known changes: when the image has answered, and when the address comes from outside. debounce (500 ms) keeps half an address from being requested while someone types; a pasted address, or one set from outside, loads at once. The status line is a polite live region, labels renames every phrase, and name posts the address.
